_comment: Player 1 on OpenBOR's own default keys (the arrows; A, S, Z, X for the four attacks; D Jump, F Special, Enter Start) and on the first pad (A Jump, X Attack, B Special, Y Attack 2, the shoulders Attack 3 and 4); players 2 to 4 on pads 2 to 4. Escape (OpenBOR's menu) is Escape and the first pad's Back.

OpenBOR.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
OpenBOR.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
OpenBOR.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
